risk_note: RV2 by the PR (rule tests under test/**; apps/api/src/modules/agent/stream/sweeper/loop.ts drives finalizeRun, which settles the Agent daily quota; app.module.ts and entry.ts wire the worker). Codex-first implementation (ops/approvals.yaml id 23). Design couli-runs/B3-03g/design.md §5.1, §5.3, §7.4, §10.1 T10 / T14. Rule tests by Claude subagents in 3 attempts plus an owner-approved extra round (couli-runs/B3-03h/owner-extra-spec-round.md: one row per step; connection, lock and unlock failures end the tick without a rejection). Codex implemented in 2 attempts (attempt 2: the entry ignores a sweeper token that resolves to the queue object of a context stub) plus one orchestrator formatting commit (prettier on entry.ts). Frozen test #39 exposed a dead pooled client in packages/db, fixed by B1-01zzc (#497); rebased onto main 610ab26, full pnpm verify passed in the isolated container on the AWS test machine (host-ephemeral PostgreSQL). Claude money-checklist review round 1 pass (the reviewer other than the implementer, ops/approvals.yaml id 27). Full verification is the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
